name: heymark
description: Plan, schedule and review social media content for your brands, and triage your inbox and comments, with your HeyMark data.

interface.longDescription:
Plan the week's content, schedule your posts, reply to messages and comments, and review how your posts performed on Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube and X.

It works with your brand's real data: what you already published, your metrics, your calendar and your brand profile. The weekly plan comes from what worked for you, replies are written in your brand voice, and what you approve gets scheduled on your social accounts.

Public actions such as replying to a comment or a direct message, publishing, or deleting always show a preview and wait for your approval. You need a HeyMark account with at least one connected social account. It works for one brand or many.
defaultPrompt: Plan next week's content for my brand.
Which messages and comments need a reply today?
How did my posts perform last month?

publication.release_notes: Initial release: weekly content plan, inbox and comment triage, performance review, and backlog to scheduled publications.

es-ES.subtitle: Planifica, programa y responde
es-ES.description:
Planifica el contenido de la semana, programa tus publicaciones, responde mensajes y comentarios y revisa cómo les fue a tus publicaciones en Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube y X.

Trabaja con los datos reales de tu marca: lo que ya publicaste, tus métricas, tu calendario y tu perfil de marca. El plan de la semana sale de lo que te funcionó, las respuestas van en la voz de tu marca y lo que apruebas queda programado en tus redes sociales.

Las acciones públicas, como responder un comentario o un mensaje directo, publicar o eliminar, siempre muestran una vista previa y esperan tu aprobación. Necesitas una cuenta de HeyMark con al menos una red social conectada. Sirve para una marca o para varias.
